verdicts.why: In 5x12 the real Deathlok, brought by Deke's backup, destroys the recreation dragging Coulson to the rift, and the two destroy the Lash, Vrellnexian and Hive recreations before Coulson closes it.

In 5x14 Ivanov comes with Hale and Creel to the Zephyr, Coulson agrees to go along, and on the Quinjet Ivanov makes him wear a mask and hand over his prosthetic hand to be scanned while Coulson needles him about the faceless Sleeper Mechs.
In 5x12 Deathlok watches the wedding and speaks only with Deke; no exchange passes between him and Fitz or Simmons, and being in the same scene without dealing with each other is not a stage.

Episode summaries and the Bishop, Master Mold and Trask pages say only that 'the X-Men' destroy the Sahara Sentinels; none places Bishop in that fight, and Bishop's own page records nothing for him there beyond joining the team, so a stage is not shown.
Mack's page: in Siberia he urges Morse to go kill Androvich while he takes Johnson back to the Zephyr; at Teddy's Bar he stays after the others leave and cries, and Morse cries as he leaves.
In 3x21 Mack defies protocol, tells Daisy that Hive is captured, forgives her and hugs her, and she breaks down crying.

In 3x22 Mack brings the wounded Yo-Yo to the room where Radcliffe, Coulson and Lincoln shelter from the Primitives; Radcliffe proposes the blowtorch over Mack's objections, and they trade lines about the heating.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18
value.text: After the mission to find Radcliffe in Bucharest, Mack tells a shaken Jemma that her bond with Fitz is not new, since the two have been close for years, and she smiles.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who confides in Mack about Fitz.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who reassures Jemma about Fitz.

verdicts.why: The event is right (Mack's page, 3x18 hotel scene), but the card lines are swapped: Mack's card (a) carried the line describing Mack, and Jemma's card carried the line describing Jemma.
In 3x13 the team gives Hunter and Bobbi a spy's goodbye at Teddy's Bar, and Mack stays after the rest walk out and cries over his friends leaving.
In 3x17 Mack and Fitz help the wounded May into a storage room at Malick's base and keep Lucio's men at bay (chlorine gas) until the Secret Warriors rescue them.
In 3x9 acting Director Mack calls May to his office for advice; she asks if he is sending back-up and tells him to make the decision for Coulson, since he already knows what to do.
In 3x9, after Price is killed, Coulson makes Mack acting Director so S.H.I.E.L.D. is not implicated in his revenge on Ward.
In 3x13 Morse, Johnson and Mackenzie seize Androvich with a smoke bomb; after the shadow knocks Johnson out, Morse runs after Androvich and kills him.

In 3x12 Morse objects in Coulson's office when Talbot pushes for Creel to join, calling him a murderer; at the symposium she and Hunter go to find Coulson and Talbot and fight Hydra's guards, regrouping with them.
In 3x3 Morse finds Simmons examining the Monolith's remains, and Simmons says it has to open because she needs to go back to the planet.
In 3x3, during Morse's knee rehab, Fitz says Simmons is distant; Morse tells him to be patient and give her something new to look forward to, and he thanks her.
In 3x12 Creel, freed of Hydra's conditioning and now Talbot's bodyguard, is held in a Containment Module where Fitz and Simmons question him about his powers and surviving the Obelisk.
In 3x12 May ambushes Creel with a metal pipe so Lincoln can electrocute him, then Talbot reveals Creel is his bodyguard; Creel later rescues Coulson and Talbot and the team fights Hydra together.
In 3x20 Daisy returns to the Playground freed by Lash and tells Talbot (the new ATCU head) that Lash was killed; Talbot questions whether it is a trick while Simmons treats her.
In 3x2 Daisy's vibrations hold the Monolith portal open until her nose bleeds, while Fitz goes through and returns with Simmons.
In 3x6 Hunter, with no assignment, joins Daisy and Mack; they I.C.E.R. Banks, take his blood and send a cloaked D.W.A.R.F. into the ATCU facility.
In 3x18 Hive and Daisy go to Bucharest, and Daisy chokes Fitz with her powers to warn him she does not want to be rescued.
In 3x22 Hive takes Daisy captive aboard Zephyr One, and May and Fitz secretly board the plane and free her.
In 3x21 Coulson updates Daisy in her Containment Module; she calls herself a brainwashed criminal like Ward, and he dismisses it as withdrawal.
In 3x20 Fitz and Simmons explain Hive's plan to Talbot, and later Talbot watches Simmons treat Daisy until she confirms Daisy is safe.
In 3x12 Talbot clashes with Hunter, who despises Creel for the deaths of Hartley and Idaho, and Talbot insists it was Whitehall's brainwashing, now cured.
In 3x12 May and Lincoln bring down Creel thinking he is after Talbot; at the symposium May locates George Talbot in Suspension Gel and the group escapes with him.
In 3x9 Ward has Giyera torture Simmons at the Hydra castle so Fitz will tell how she returned from the planet, and later tortures her himself.
In 3x4 Kebo brings Hunter to Hydra's 'Director', Ward; Hunter refuses Ward's deal to spare Garner and shoots Ward as he flees.
In 3x4 May arrives as Hunter's backup; Ward threatens to have Strucker kill Garner unless they let him go, and May protests when Hunter refuses.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
value.text: When Hunter and Bobbi have to leave S.H.I.E.L.D., Jemma sends them the first drink across a bar in a silent spy's goodbye.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Friend Jemma says goodbye to with a drink across a bar.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who sends Hunter a farewell drink across a bar.

verdicts.why: The event is right (3x13 spy's goodbye, Simmons sends the first shot), but the line on Jemma's card says Hunter says goodbye to her with a drink; he receives the drink, she sends it.
In 3x19 Lincoln injects himself with Fitz and Simmons' Hive cure against orders and refuses Simmons' counter-drug; she later tells him in containment it did not work.
In 3x17, after the Zephyr's violent landing at Malick's Schoonebeek base, the team gets the wounded May into a storage room and Simmons tends her wound until the Secret Warriors arrive.
In 3x9, after Ward kills Price, Coulson interviews his original team about Ward; Simmons says she was attracted to Ward but he never returned it.
In 3x13 Fitz is among the team at Teddy's Bar who send Hunter and Bobbi shots in a spy's goodbye after they are disavowed.
